xml_content: yang na de dag kyang bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig gsuM las ldog pa yin no zhes gsung ngo{°}ngo ||Cf. the position criticized in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VII 171,18-22: la la bya rdzogs skad cig gsum || 'ga' zhig yul ring 'grogs zhes zer || kha cig spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis bya ba rdzogs pa'i skad cig gsum la ldog pa dang | kha cig da lta nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du bskal pa dpag med du gnod bya gnod byed 'grog so zhes zer ba. The authors are identified in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 155,15 as "slob dpon bZad pa" and "slob dpon Cha pa" (i.e. Phya pa) etc. (slob dpo bzad pa dang | slob dpon cha pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig | spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis da lta nas rdo rjes lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi bar du bsal pa dpag tu med par gnod bya dang gnod byed du 'grogs so zhes zer ba dang | la la dag bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gsum la spang bya ldog go zhes zer ba).
